headline: It's tea that got a little wild.

results.say: every colour is a brand colour
every font is a brand font
none of the brand's never-words appears
no logo file: the brand name is set in type instead

judge.say: The headline asks the reader to do nothing; the call to action is the only verb on the page.
The accent colour is used only on the shape: the piece feels more oat than brick.
The image prompt answers the headline well: one jar, no people, daylight.
